app.name: COAL
app.tagline: R&D at Jayon, from idea to launch

signIn.intro: Enter your name to sign in.
signIn.name: Your name
signIn.noSuchAccount: There's no account with that name. Check the spelling, or create one.

signUp.title: Create an account
signUp.intro: Enter your name and choose your position on Jayon's R&D chart. A Lead or a design engineer also chooses their product line.
signUp.name: Your name

signUp.seatsPerLine: {count, plural, one {One person per product line.} other {Up to # people per product line.}}

profile.title: Your profile
profile.intro: Until there's real sign-in, you can change your own name, position and product line. A position with no seat left can't be chosen.
profile.reportsToNobody: Nobody is above you on the chart.

switcher.demoOnly: Demo: switch to anyone, no sign-out

people.title: People
people.intro: Jayon's R&D chart: who reports to whom, who holds each position, and the seats still open.
people.switchHint: Demo: click a name to take that person's place. You can switch again from the circle at the top.
people.boardNote: The Managing Director and the CEO both sign as the Board, at steps 4 and 23.
people.switchText: You will see COAL as {name}, {title}. Everything you do is done as them, until you switch again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.empty: There are no widgets for your role yet.
dashboard.templatesText: The Word templates every document is made from. Add a new version, check it and make it active.

workstation.title: Workstation
workstation.askAboutTask: Open a chat about this task
workstation.conversationEmpty: Ask a question, find a document or ask someone to do something. The assistant only acts when you ask, and it sees only what you can see.
workstation.usedWeb: This chat has used the web, so the assistant only prepares cards for you to check.

examples.two: Which projects are late, and why?
examples.three: What am I signing, and what changed?

pin.clear: Start a chat about nothing in particular

composer.label: Message
composer.hint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line. Type @ to find a person, project or document. The assistant can make mistakes: check what matters.
composer.attachHelp: Attach documents (PDF, Word, text, CSV) or pictures (PNG, JPEG, WebP): up to {count} files of {limit} each. You can also paste a screenshot.
composer.webOnHelp: The assistant may look things up on the public web in this chat. Only its questions leave COAL, after COAL checks them, and you see each one. Click to switch it off.
composer.webOffHelp: The assistant won't look anything up on the web in this chat. Click to switch it on.

sources.empty: The records the assistant used to answer appear here.

sources.fromWebNote: Public pages, found by the web assistant. Check what matters on the page itself.

fill.version: Written for version {version}. Confirming saves a new draft version.

mode.append: Added at the end of this part.

template.first: The first template of this kind

layout.kept: Your Word file's layout is kept.

template.draftNote: Saved as a draft. Make it active on the Templates page when you are happy with it.

template.approvedByHelp: Leave empty for the step's own signer.
template.fieldTypeName: Name of the kind of document

research.question: The question (stays in COAL)
research.termsNote: Only these words are searched, nothing else.
research.linksOnly: You open these, with the search ready
research.startedNote: The research assistant is searching. You'll get a notification when the brief is ready.

draft.label: Draft
draft.note: Saved for you to read and edit. Nothing is submitted: that is yours to do.

problems.NOT_SIGNED_IN: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
problems.NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find that. It may have been removed.
problems.NAME_TAKEN: Someone already has that name. Add an initial or a surname.
problems.POSITION_FULL: That position has no seat left. Choose another one, or ask who holds it.
problems.VERSION_CONFLICT: Your profile changed since you opened it. Reload and try again.
problems.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some of the values aren't valid. Check them and try again.
problems.RATE_LIMITED: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
problems.NOT_ALLOWED: Only these people can do this: {who}.
problems.STEP_NOT_READY: That step isn't open for this, or it has already moved on. Reload and check.
problems.PROJECT_NOT_ACTIVE: The project is on hold or finished, so this can't be done now.
problems.DECISION_REQUIRED: Record the decisions at this step first.
problems.AI_NOT_ALLOWED: The assistant may not do this.
problems.NO_TEMPLATE: There's no template for this kind of document yet. Upload the document instead, or ask the VP or the R&D Head to add the template.
problems.DOCUMENT_LOCKED: This document can't change now. Its step may be closed, or this version may already be with signers or approved.
problems.SEPARATION_OF_DUTIES: The same person can't sign both Prepared and Approved on one version. Someone else needs to sign this row.
problems.PDF_UNAVAILABLE: The PDF couldn't be made just now. Try again in a moment.
problems.FILE_NOT_SCANNED: This file hasn't been checked for viruses yet. Try again in a moment.
problems.DEVIATION_REQUIRED: This is past its due date. Record why it is late, and the new date, first.
problems.DOCUMENTS_NEEDED: This step's documents aren't ready, so it can't be submitted yet:
problems.UPLOAD_NOT_ALLOWED: That file can't be uploaded. Check its type and size.
problems.UPLOAD_INCOMPLETE: The file wasn't fully uploaded. Try again.
problems.PREVIEW_CHANGED: Something changed while you were looking. Check the preview again.
problems.PROPOSAL_EXPIRED: This card has expired. Ask again for a new one.
problems.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The assistant isn't available just now. Try again in a moment.
problems.AI_BUDGET_REACHED: You have used today's assistant budget. It starts again tomorrow.
problems.CHAT_BUSY: The assistant is still answering. Wait for it, or stop it first.
problems.upload_type: That kind of file can't be uploaded. Allowed: {types}.
problems.upload_size: That file is too big. The limit is {limit}.
problems.upload_transfer: The file couldn't be sent. Check your connection and try again.
problems.USE_THE_STEP: This task belongs to a step, so it follows the step. Start the step and submit it for sign-off from the step, and the task closes when the step is signed off.
problems.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: A public source didn't answer. Try again later.
problems.NOT_WITH_SIGNERS: This step isn't waiting for a sign-off, so there is nobody to remind.
problems.ALREADY_REMINDED: They were already reminded today. They can be reminded again tomorrow.

task.claimText: “{title}” moves from your role's queue to you. If you aren't on the project's team yet, you join it.
task.acceptText: “{title}” becomes your task, and the person who asked is told.
task.doneText: “{title}” is closed as finished. Check that the work is complete before you confirm.

prerequisite.title: Record “{name}”?
prerequisite.text: It is recorded under your name with the time, and the steps that wait for it can open.

source.offText: Research runs stop searching it until it is switched on again.
source.onText: Research runs can search it again.

research.stopText: The run stops where it is. You can start a new one later.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Everyone can see where every project stands.
projects.noneForVp: No projects yet. Start one with Go.

newProject.title: Go: start a project
newProject.intro: Go turns the VP's concept into a project. It opens steps 1, 2 and 2a and creates their tasks.
newProject.onlyVp: Only the VP can start a project.
newProject.name: Project name
newProject.description: The concept, in a few lines
newProject.teamHint: The Lead of the product line, the Head and the AEMS expert join automatically when one person holds each role. Tick anyone else who should join.
newProject.previewDone: This is what Go will do. Nothing is saved yet.

preview.cancelled: {count, plural, one {# open task will be cancelled} other {# open tasks will be cancelled}}

project.slipAhead: {count, plural, one {# day ahead} other {# days ahead}}
project.noTeam: Nobody is on the team yet.
project.corrective: {count, plural, =0 {No open corrective actions} one {# open corrective action} other {# open corrective actions}}
project.dropWarning: Dropping cancels every open task. Every record is kept.
project.signOffNote: Signing is a confirmed click for now. Face ID and fingerprint signing comes later.

step.noSigner: No sign-off: a doer marks it done
step.needs: Needs before it can go on
step.prerequisiteHoldsUp: {count, plural, one {Step {steps} waits for it} other {Steps {steps} wait for it}}
step.sendBackReason: Why? Add the QC or lab finding.
step.resetPreview: These steps would be reset. Their documents carry over as drafts, and their open tasks are cancelled.
step.daysLate: {count, plural, one {# working day late} other {# working days late}}
step.needsDeviation: {count, plural, =0 {This step is past its planned end} one {This step is # working day late} other {This step is # working days late}}, and nobody has said why. Record why before it is submitted.
step.lateBeforeSubmit: This step is late, so it can't be submitted until you say why. Record it, and you can then submit the step.
step.submitConfirmText: {signer} is asked to sign it off. While it waits, its documents can't be changed, and only {signer} can return it to you.
step.doneConfirmText: This step has no sign-off, so it is done at once and the steps after it open.
step.handedInNone: No documents are attached to this step.
step.startConfirmText: The step is marked in progress and its tasks start.
step.approveConfirmText: You sign off this step. Your name, role and the time are recorded against its sign-off record, and the steps that wait for it can open.
step.decideConfirmText: Your answer, “{answer}”, is signed with your name and the time. Check it before you confirm.

tasks.title: My tasks
tasks.intro: What is assigned to you, what is waiting for your role, and what you asked others for.
tasks.declineIntro: Say why. {name} will see it on the task.
tasks.newTitle: Give work, ask for something, or note a task for yourself
tasks.newIntro: Work for someone below you on the reporting line is assigned to them. Anything else goes as a request they can accept or decline.
tasks.becomesOwn: This goes on your own task list.
tasks.becomesRequest: This goes to {name} as a request.
tasks.daysLate: {count, plural, one {# day late} other {# days late}}
tasks.lateIntro: This task is past its due date, so it can't be marked done until you say why. Record it, and the task is marked done straight after.
tasks.followsStepNote: Part of step {key}: start it and submit it for sign-off from the step. This task closes when the step is signed off.
tasks.followsStepWaiting: With the signer for step {key}. This task closes when the step is signed off.
tasks.followsStepSign: Sign this off from step {key}. The task closes when you have signed.

signOffWait.late: Their date was {date}, {count, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}} ago.
signOffWait.lateBadge: {role}: {count, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}} late
signOffWait.confirmText: {names} will get a notification that the sign-off on step {step} is waiting for them. They can be reminded once a day.

type.document_submitted: A document was submitted for signing
type.document_returned: A document was returned to its authors
type.document_carried_forward: A document was carried forward into the new iteration
type.signature_requested: A document is waiting for a signature
type.signature_reminded: The signers of step {step} were reminded

templates.title: Templates
templates.intro: A template is Jayon's own Word form, as it is. Upload a new version, check it, and approve it: it replaces the one in use. People download the approved blank form, fill it in, and upload it, or fill it in with the assistant.
templates.onlyManagers: Only the VP and the R&D Head manage templates.
templates.checksTitle: What COAL checks when you upload a new version
templates.checkWord: It is a valid Word (.docx) file.
templates.checkPlaceholders: COAL does not look inside it for fields: the form is used as Jayon wrote it. Any words in curly brackets (placeholders) are emptied in the blank form people download.
templates.checkSample: A PDF of the blank form can be made from it.
templates.reuseSpec: How COAL fills templates in itself (fields from its records) is parked until it is agreed with Jayon.
templates.keepsVersion: A new version is saved as a draft. Approving it makes it the one in use and retires the current one, which is kept. Documents already made keep the form they were made from.
templates.noVersions: There is no form for this kind of document yet. Upload Jayon's Word form below.
templates.activateExplain: Approve version {n} as the {type} form? It replaces the one in use for new documents: that version is retired and kept. Documents already made keep the form they were made from.
templates.checksFailed: COAL can't use this file. Fix what is listed, then upload it again.
templates.savedAsDraft: Version {n} is saved as a draft, with a PDF of the form. It isn't used yet: approve it when it is ready. The VP or the R&D Head can do that, including whoever uploaded it.
templates.othersNote: These have no Word template, so there is nothing to upload here.
templates.kindUpload: the file is uploaded by the author

files.open: Open the file in a new tab

documents.heading: Documents
documents.signoffNote: The step's signer signs the sign-off record when they approve the step.
documents.noTypes: No documents are made at this step.
documents.noTemplate: There's no template for {type} yet. Upload the file instead, or ask the VP or the R&D Head to add the template.
documents.how: How do you want to start it?
documents.formExplain: {name} is made from Jayon's Word form (version {n}). Download the blank form and fill it in, or start a copy here and fill it in with the assistant or in Word.
documents.fromTemplate: Fill it in here, from the template: {name} (version {n})
documents.fromCopy: Start a copy of the blank form here, to fill in with the assistant or in Word
documents.fromUpload: Upload the form I filled in

attachments.title: Attachments and sources
attachments.count: {count, plural, =0 {none yet} one {# item} other {# items}}
attachments.caption: Caption (optional)
attachments.projectNone: Nothing kept for the whole project yet. Research results and references kept here are read by everyone working on it, and the assistant uses them.
attachments.projectOnSteps: {count, plural, one {# more source is} other {# more sources are}} kept on steps and documents.

document.signoffNote: The step's signer signs this when they approve the step. It is made by COAL and can't be edited.
document.restricted: Its content is restricted: only the Board, the VP and the R&D Head can open this paper. You can see its title and outcome here.
document.noVersion: There is no version you can see yet.
document.wordHow: This is a Word form. Download it and fill it in, then upload it below as a new version. Or ask the assistant to fill in what it can from the project's records and what you tell it: it saves a new version for you to read and edit.
document.fillWithAssistant: Fill it in with the assistant
document.fillSay: Fill in this document from what the project already records, and ask me for anything you need.
document.earlierVersion: You are looking at an earlier version. The latest is version {latest}. Saving from here makes a new version from this one.
document.discardChanges: You have changes that aren't saved. Leave them behind?
document.savedAsVersion: Saved as version {n}. The earlier versions are kept.
document.savingMakesNew: Saving makes a new version. Nothing is overwritten, and the earlier versions are kept.
document.uploadNewVersion: Upload a new version of the file
document.writtenByAssistant: Written by the assistant: read it, and edit anything that isn't right.

signing.notice: Signing is a confirmed click for now; Face ID / fingerprint signing comes later.
signing.heading: Signatures
signing.notSubmitted: Not submitted for signing yet. Once it is, it is signed in these rows:
signing.confirmSignText: You are about to sign as {meaning}. Your name, role and the time are recorded with the content and PDF hashes, and can't be changed afterwards.
signing.hashNote: Each signature is tied to these two hashes. If the document changed by even one character, they would no longer match.
signing.submitExplain: Version {n} is signed as Prepared by you, and the next row opens for its signers. Once it is with signers, it can't be edited.
signing.saveFirst: You have changes that aren't saved. Save them first: the saved version is what is submitted.
signing.confirmSubmit: Confirm: submit and sign as Prepared

compare.heading: Compare versions
compare.legend: Green text was added. Red struck-through text was removed.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.goHint: The targets you want to track for this project, such as Board approval by a date. You can leave this empty, and add or change them later on the project page.
milestones.none: No milestones are set for this project.
milestones.noneEditor: No milestones yet. Add the targets you want to track for this project.
milestones.followsStep: Step {key}: reached when the step is finished

status.late: {days, plural, =0 {Late} one {# working day late} other {# working days late}}

confirm.removeText: It is no longer tracked for this project, and its record is kept.
confirm.reachText: It is recorded under your name with today's date, and no longer counts as late.
confirm.unreachText: It goes back to being tracked against its target date.

healthReasons.milestone_at_risk: Milestone “{milestone}” will miss its target date on the current forecast

deviation.title: Record why it is late
deviation.intro: Say what held the work up and when you now expect it. The next role up confirms or corrects it.
deviation.noTask: There is no open task here to record it against.
deviation.heading: Deviations

timeline.heading: Timeline
timeline.baselineLater: The baseline is set when the VP signs the Action Plan. Until then each step runs on its default length.
timeline.writePlanText: Give each role its start and end on the remaining steps. The VP's sign-off on the Action Plan makes these dates the baseline. Rows left empty are not saved.
timeline.needBoth: Give both a start and an end, or leave both empty.
timeline.endBeforeStart: The end can't be before the start.
timeline.planFilled: {count, plural, =0 {No dates filled in} one {# row will be saved} other {# rows will be saved}}
timeline.planSaved: {count, plural, =0 {Plan saved} one {Plan saved: # row} other {Plan saved: # rows}}
timeline.draftText: These dates are not final. They become the baseline when the VP signs the Action Plan.
timeline.workingDays: {count, plural, one {# working day} other {# working days}}
timeline.noChanges: No date has been changed since the baseline.
timeline.changeText: The baseline stays as it is, because the on-time rate is measured against it. The change is recorded with your reason.
timeline.nothingToChange: No step has dates that can be changed now.
timeline.onlyVpLaunch: Only the VP can change the dates of step {step}, the launch.

widgets.moreRows: {count, plural, one {# more. Open the widget to see it.} other {# more. Open the widget to see them.}}
widgets.rowCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to show} one {# row} other {# rows}}
widgets.lateIntro: This task is past its due date, so it can't be marked done until you say why. Record it, and the task is marked done straight after.

empty.my-tasks: Nothing is waiting for you right now.
empty.waiting-signature: Nothing is waiting for your signature.
empty.coming-up: None of your steps are due to open soon.
empty.my-projects: You aren't on a project yet.
empty.delays-risks: Nothing is late or at risk.

research.title: Research
research.intro: What already exists outside the company: products on the market, published results, trials and safety problems. Ask the assistant in the Workstation (/research). It prepares a card with the search words, and nothing leaves COAL until you confirm.
research.none: No research yet. In the Workstation, type /research and say what you want to know.
research.results: {count, plural, =0 {no results} one {# result} other {# results}}
research.termsNote: Only these words were searched. The question stays in COAL.
research.nothingSearched: nothing; only places to open yourself.
research.running: The research assistant is searching. This page updates by itself, and you'll get a notification.
research.linksNote: COAL can't search these places for you. Each opens with the search words filled in.
research.briefNote: Written by the research assistant from the results below. Check each point against its result before you rely on it.
research.resultsNote: Tick the ones worth keeping. Kept results become sources of the project: everyone working on it can read them, and the assistant can use and cite them.
research.keepTitle: Keep as sources of the project
research.keptNote: {count, plural, one {# result kept} other {# results kept}} as sources of the project. Everyone working on it can read them, and the assistant can use them.
research.searchesNote: Every search that left COAL, as it was sent.
research.found: {count, plural, =0 {nothing found} one {# found} other {# found}}
research.keepNoProject: This research isn't for a project yet. It stays here, so once the project exists (the VP presses Go), come back and keep what you need as sources of the project. Everyone working on it, such as the R&D Head writing the inception document, can then read them, and the assistant can use them at any point.
research.keptNoteStep: {count, plural, one {# result kept} other {# results kept}} as sources of step {step}.

sourceLibrary.title: Source library
sourceLibrary.intro: The places COAL may search when someone researches what already exists, and when to use each. The research assistant reads the notes. Only general search words ever leave COAL, and only after a person confirms them.
sourceLibrary.manageNote: The VP, the R&D Head and the R&D Leads add, change and switch off sources.
sourceLibrary.dialogIntro: Choose what kind of place it is: COAL knows how to search each kind. A link is a place you open yourself.
sourceLibrary.websiteNote: Searched with the assistant's web search, limited to these websites, where the AI provider has one. Until then, you open it.
sourceLibrary.pubmedTitleHelp: Such as J Spine Surg. With it, the journal is searched through PubMed; without it, through Crossref by its ISSN.
sourceLibrary.fieldDomains: Websites, one per line, without https://
sourceLibrary.urlHelp: An https address. '{q}' in it becomes the search words.
sourceLibrary.noteHelp: The research assistant reads this to choose where to look.
